messages:
elaine: Draft of the launch post is up — focused on Optimize (cost + perf). Added three short video snackables (15s/30s/60s) and a hero benchmark callout. Need 1) copy review 2) legal quick-pass 3) webinar CTA + HubSpot routing. Can folks take a look today? :eyes:

samir: Nice timing. Quick ask: can we make the benchmark claim more concrete? instead of 'orders of magnitude' use something like 'up to 3.4x throughput at 25% lower token cost' with a link to the benchmark doc. Also recommend a short TL;DR at the top for skimmers.

maria: Legal quick-pass: flagged one phrase — 'guaranteed 50% cost savings' is too strong. Suggest 'can reduce costs by up to 50% in our tests' or 'customers have seen up to 50% reduction in token cost in our benchmarks.' otherwise looks fine. I can sign off after that minor tweak. :white_check_mark: 

josh: For webinar CTA + inbound routing: I propose the blog CTA goes to the webinar landing page, which on success fires HubSpot form submission + workflow that tags contact with "Launch - Optimize - Webinar" and sets lifecycle stage to MQL if open rate > 0? (typo) — kidding. Real flow: form -> workflow "Launch: Optimize Webinar" -> assign to SDR queue "Product Launch" if company_size > 50. Will share exact workflow name and triggers.

josh: sample HubSpot naming snippet we should use (please copy/paste into ops template):
```
Workflow name: Launch - Optimize Webinar - Blog Registrants
Trigger: Form submission = Optimize Webinar Landing Form
Action 1: Add contact to list: Launch - Optimize - Webinar
Action 2: Set contact property: Lifecycle stage = MQL
Action 3: Create task: Assign to SDR queue = Product Launch (if company_size > 50)
```

nora: Video note: I'll export three variants with captions and consistent brand color bars. For the 15s snackable, lead with the 3.4x throughput stat, then CTA overlay: "See the full benchmark + register." Will drop MP4s to the shared drive by EOD.

elaine: Updated the hero claim per maria and samir: changed to 'in our internal benchmarks, Optimize improved throughput up to 3.4x while reducing per-token compute cost by as much as 50%.' Pushed new draft to the doc. Also added a short skimmer TL;DR.

samir: Perfect. One more micro edit: replace 'per-token compute cost' with 'per-token inference cost' — more precise. Also add a short sidebar explaining test rig (model, sequence length, GPU type). That will keep questions down.

maria: Approved after wording change. No further legal flags.

josh: I'll set up the HubSpot workflow and the list. Quick ask: what UTM params do we want on the blog CTA? Suggest `utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch`. Anyone object?

elaine: That UTM looks good. Also add `utm_content=video15` for the 15s clip links.

content-bot: Reminder: publish checklist from template:
- hero image (nora)
- final copy (elaine)
- legal signoff (maria)
- webinar landing page live (josh)
- assets uploaded to CDN (nora)
- HubSpot workflow active (josh)
- social copy variants (samir)

elaine: Thanks — I'll finalize the copy now and queue for publishing tomorrow morning if all assets + workflow look good. Planning webinar promo cadence: day 0 blog, day 2 social push (video 15s + 30s), day 5 reminder email to registrants, day 7 webinar. Sound reasonable?

samir: Sounds good. I'll draft social copy and short experiment variants for A/B (headline vs stat-first).

nora: Uploaded rough MP4s to /shared/marketing/optimize-launch/videos/ — will update final files after feedback.

josh: Workflow created and paused for final test. I'll unpause once Elaine confirms publish time.

elaine: Great, if no objections I'll swap 'compute' -> 'inference' and hit publish at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
